exposure: taking in-house calls during the last month of pregnancy
outcome: health and safety (of self or child)
recommendation against field of medicine for female students
cohort: 1,690 physician mothers from all specialties who had children during their U.S. residency training, recruited from online Facebook support groups.
finding: Many physician mothers experienced discrimination, worked until delivery despite safety concerns, reported pregnancy complications, and faced inadequate parental leave leading to high rates of postpartum depression and marital distress.
followup_time: Up to 1 year postpartum for some outcomes (e.g., marital distress, breastfeeding duration).
cross-section timing: N/A (data collected via electronic survey, specific timing of survey administration not specified, but reflects experiences during residency/fellowship).
